question: Which statuses can a person give a slice in a plan file (proposed for the links stage, L2)?
answer: Proposed: Not Started, In Progress, Done and Dropped — the plan item statuses without Now and Blocked; the product owner decides at checkpoint 3.

trace.asked: the statuses a plan file already gives its nodes, and their meanings
trace.found: six statuses: Not Started, In Progress, Now, Blocked, Done, Dropped; Now and Blocked describe one open change or one wait

source.text:
## The statuses

Every node of a plan has one of six statuses. The order below is the order of the legend.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Not Started | Not started. |
| In Progress | Started, but no one works on it in an open change right now. |
| Now | Someone works on it in an open change right now. |
| Blocked | Cannot go on until something else is settled. |
| Done | Finished. |
| Dropped | Closed as not planned, or as a duplicate. Kept for the history. |
